title: Used demand changes commitment economics
method: Synthetic 1,000-hour commitment at $0.60/hour versus $1/hour on demand. At 750 used hours benefit is $150; at 500 it is a $100 disadvantage. Excludes financing, taxes and program-specific conditions.
alt: Used demand changes commitment economics. Commitment obligation: 600 USD/month; 750h on demand: 750 USD/month; 500h on demand: 500 USD/month. Illustrative values.
